programme.desc: For someone like Capt. Cory who's out on the water most days of the year, it's easy to notice the little changes that show the stress on an ecosystem. "I wish we would get to a point where we really put our foot down and do something about it before it's too late." - Watch this episode to learn more about what's going on and to see why Capt.
